## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base problem replaces the transient dunk interaction with an instructor-specified equivalent end load and models the horizontal arm as a solid rectangular cantilever. Connection stresses, fatigue, vibration, impact dynamics, and local stress concentrations are intentionally excluded.
:::
